name: Tíjola (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, yellow and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Tíjola (a tower and a chequy field on yellow above waves).
history: The municipal council of Tíjola applied on 26 October 2004 for the entry of its flag in the Andalusian register of local entities, under Law 6/2003 of 9 October on symbols of local entities; the flag is rectangular in the proportion 11 by 18, composed of three stripes perpendicular to the staff, blue, gold yellow and green.

features.role: Tíjola arms — tower and chequy above waves
